title: Why your credit score punishes you for having no debt
description:
Pay cash for everything and your score can be worse than someone in debt. Here is the reason.

New video every day.

scenes.say: You have no debt. You pay cash for everything. And your credit score is worse than your friend who owes money.
That feels broken. It is not. It is measuring something other than what you think.
A credit score does not measure wealth. It measures how reliably you repay borrowed money. If you have never borrowed, there is nothing to measure.
To a lender, no history is not the same as a good history. It is an empty file. And an empty file is a risk.
That is why someone with a small, boring, always paid card can score higher than someone with no card at all.
You are not scored on how good you are with your money. You are scored on how predictable you are with theirs.
